item.title: Pine Bluff authorities now investigating hit-and-run as homicide
item.description: Authorities in Pine Bluff are now investigating a Sunday hit-and-run as a homicide.

item.title: Advanced DNA testing identifies remains in almost 20-year-old Arkansas cold case
item.description: The remains from a nearly 20-year-old cold case have been identified after using advanced DNA testing, according to the Attorney General Tim Griffin of Arkansas.

item.title: Three-year-old missing from Lonoke County found safe
item.description: Authorities said they are searching for a three-year-old girl who was reported missing from Lonoke County on Monday.

item.title: Desha County sheriff seeking reelection responds to posts he states are trying to 'publicly humiliate' him
item.description: Desha County Sheriff Mitch Grant posted to Facebook late Tuesday the details of a social media campaign that he feels is designed to embarrass him and his chances for reelection.

item.title: Arkansas Capitol to reopen historic bronze door entrance to public after 25 years
item.description: A historic entrance at the Arkansas State Capitol will be opening once again to the public after more than 20 years.

item.title: Entergy Arkansas updates operations center
item.description: Entergy Arkansas has worked on upgrades to its operations center to keep up with advancements in technology, officials said.

item.title: Businesses in Jacksonville get relief as Gregory overpass opens
item.description: The Gregory overpass in Jacksonville officially opened Wednesday morning, marking a major milestone in a construction project that began in spring 2023.

item.title: Neighbors react after Pine Bluff man is killed in hit-and-run homicide
item.description: A hit-and-run that left a 68-year-old man dead Saturday night is now being investigated as a homicide, according to Pine Bluff Police.

item.title: Arkansas father & daughter coach against each other in softball doubleheader
item.description: The bond between a father and a daughter is special. For the University of Ozarks Head Softball Coach David Kuhn and his daughter, Taylor their bond is built around this game.

item.title: Man facing prostitution charges after Hot Springs police execute search warrant at salon
item.description: Authorities executed a search warrant at Johnson's Tanning Salon in Hot Springs, Arkansas on Wednesday morning, resulting in the arrest of 48-year-old Jeffery Adam Kloss on charges of criminal use of property, prostitution, promoting prostitution, and firearm possession.
